# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This batch contains a very large number of short call snippets, but the majority are **internal-operations noise**: driver/loading coordination, "vehicle vந்துச்சா", bill-copy handovers, payment-collection follow-ups, attendance/app issues, and even unrelated cold-calls from third parties (bulk-SMS vendor, Google-promotion vendor, a "Prom Trade" expo organiser). These were excluded.

Genuine **sales-relevant** calls that remain show Crayon Roofing & Structures operating primarily as a **Chennai-based dealer/converter of JSW Steel colour-coated roofing sheets** (brands: Color On Plus, Pragathi, Indradhanush, Radiance, Silver On Plus), plus a secondary basket of **roofing accessories and adjacent building products**: PUF sandwich panels (roof/wall), polycarbonate sheets (solid/compact/multiwall), tile-profile roofing sheets, MS pipe & purlins (Z/C), screws & nut-bolts (Tata brand), welding rods, and occasional project-grade items like polycarbonate noise-barrier sheets for an L&T bullet-train job.

The calls are a mix of: (a) B2B dealer/customer enquiries for rate & stock, (b) running negotiations with sub-dealers (Coimbatore/Tirunelveli/expo contacts) on cash-vs-credit pricing, (c) recurring payment-ageing conversations with customers running 28–62 day overdue bills, and (d) a cluster of difficult calls around **tile-profile roofing sheet delivery delays** (customer expected 2–3 days, factory needs ~20 days) that escalated into a refund demand. Given the volume of repeated/duplicate snippets and heavy ops content, the *unique* sales signal is moderate — this KB is built strictly from what is actually said, without inventing scope beyond it.

## Products & brand ladder

- **Roofing sheets (core product)** — JSW Steel colour-coated sheets, sold under three in-house brand tiers:
  - **Color On Plus** – premium tier, thickness 0.47mm / 0.50mm / 0.60mm. Colors: Sky Blue, Off White/Half White, Graphite Grey (=Pencil Grey), Royal Blue (=Nova/Dark Blue), Brick Red, Turquoise Blue, Mist Green, Non-color "Bare".
  - **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** – mid tier, 0.47mm, colors limited to Sky Blue & Off White only: "Pragathi sky blue off white மட்டும்தான் சார்" [Pragathi only comes in sky blue, off-white, sir].
  - **Indradhanush** – entry tier, 0.45mm, GL base, same limited colors.
  - **Radiance** – JSW's separate line; stock is thin: "அதுவுமே last-ஆ இப்போ sky blue மட்டும் தான் இருக்கு available" [Even that, only sky blue is left in stock now].
  - Plain (uncoated) sheet and bare coil also sold, roughly ₹30/m² cheaper than colour sheet.
- **Tile-profile roofing sheets** — a slow, made-to-order profile machine product; repeatedly flagged as a bottleneck (20 days vs customer expectation of days).
- **PUF / sandwich panels** — Roof panel and Wall panel, 30mm/40mm/50mm thickness, standard coil thickness "4035" (top 40, bottom 35); custom thickness needs ≥200 sq.m. to justify a coil change.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** — Solid (clear/compact), Multiwall, thickness mainly 2mm; "Embossed clear" offered as nearest substitute when true clear 4mm not in stock.
- **Noise-barrier polycarbonate sheets** — a specialised, high-value, project-only item (₹30,000–40,000 per sheet) tied to L&T bullet-train/metro noise-barrier work; team explicitly treats this as outside normal trading scope ("totally project order").
- **Accessories** — L-flashing, rain cutter, ridge, canopy/crimp sheets, corner flashing — all made-to-drawing, priced by size.
- **Structural items** — MS Pipe, Z-purlin, C-purlin (confirmed when a customer asked "Structures-னா pipe எல்லாமே wholesale-ஆ madam?").
- **Fasteners & consumables** — Tata-brand self-drilling screws (1 inch, 19mm stitch, 3 inch, 5.5"/130mm), welding rods, nut-bolt (noted as *not* stocked — "nut bolt நம்ம பண்றது இல்ல").

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- Color On Plus 0.47mm: **₹435–445 + GST/m²** (quoted variably across calls; also kg-basis **₹117–119 + GST/kg**)
- Color On Plus 0.50mm: **₹465–475 + GST/m²**; kg-basis **₹117 + GST/kg**
- Color On Plus Turquoise Blue: **₹475 + GST/m²** (₹10 premium over standard colors)
- Pragathi 0.47mm: **₹370/kg** or **₹405–410 + GST/m²**; Pragathi Plus coil: **₹370/m²**
- Indradhanush 0.45mm: **₹97 + GST/kg**, or ₹370–375 "catch & carry" rate
- Plain sheet: **₹400/m²** (≈₹30–35 cheaper than colour-coated)
- PUF Roof panel 50mm: **₹1500/sq ft**; Wall panel 50mm: **₹1450/sq ft**; Roof panel 30mm (top40/bottom35): **₹1300/sq ft**; loading charge quoted as **₹1.25/m²** or flat **₹1000**
- Polycarbonate compact clear 2mm: **₹850 + GST**; solid clear 2mm: **₹1250 + GST**; a generic "sheet" quote also appears at **₹800 + GST** (unit basis unclear in transcript)
- Screws (Tata): 1" — **₹2.93 + GST**; 19mm stitch — **₹2.11 + GST**; 3" — **₹9.41 + GST**; 5.5"/130mm — **₹13 + GST**
- GST is added on top of every quoted rate; loading/transport is billed separately.
- **Minimum order rules**: custom PUF thickness change requires ≥200 m² to justify a coil change; tile-profile minimum lead time stated as **"day & night running also minimum 20 days"** for ~200 sheets, factory capacity capped at **½ ton/day** on the tile line.
- **Credit terms**: standard expectation is **30 days**; multiple calls chase customers at **28, 38, 50, 62 days** overdue. One dealer call explicitly states a **switch policy from credit to "cash & carry"/advance-only** pricing during a stock-fund crunch: "credit-ன்னு இன்னும் பிரச்சனை வருது. அதனால அதே price கொடுத்துட்டேன்" [credit is becoming a problem, so I gave the same (cash) price].
- **Advance**: typically ₹5,000–₹10,000 advance mentioned to lock a size/spec change before production.
- A dealer-margin practice is explicitly described: internal "dealer price" is passed through with a small markup added on top for the sales rep's own margin before quoting the end customer (e.g., "425 குடுத்துருக்கீங்க... 61 rupees add பண்ணி 486 போட்டுருக்கேன்" [you gave 425, I added ₹61 to make it 486]).
